project: Wuxia Life Early Childhood Opening Experience Governance (Stage-2)
description: Stage-2 governance and live acceptance for infant/preschool opening: confirm Stage-1 agency baseline, close regression gates, run 3–4 year API browser playtest, audit four-origin 0–7 divergence, and produce closure report. Validation-only PRD—no Stage-3/4 content implementation. Product truth: docs/PRD/early-childhood-opening-experience-governance.md.

userStories.title: Stage-1 Baseline Confirmation Audit
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only confirmation that Stage-1 agency mechanisms are wired as designed so that Stage-2 validation targets the right surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm shouldOfferDailyPlanning(age) returns false for ages 0–4 and true from age 5 (within childhood band rules in src/p16/childhoodAgency.ts)
Confirm SessionPhase includes passive_progression and period_summary with passive_continue and period_summary ProgressionAckKind values
Confirm ageActionStatCaps clamps chivalry, internalSkill, and martialPower at infant band (age ≤ INFANT_MAX_AGE)
Record findings with reproducible commands in docs/test-reports/early-childhood-stage1-baseline-confirmation.md (create if missing)
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-001; §12 dependency root; frozen agency table §3; touchpoints childhoodAgency.ts, sessionProgression contracts, ageActionStatCaps.ts; non-goals §6 (no adult line, no Stage-3/4 implementation)

userStories.title: Regression Gate Closure After Passive Childhood
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want all childhood-agency regression gates green after Stage-1 so that passive opening does not break CI or playability baselines.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run gate:p16 exits with decision pass
npm exec tsx tests/headless/p72SessionPhase.test.ts prints ok (infant passive_progression case included)
npm run test -- p16OriginDestiny completes without failure (including chained p9PlayabilityTests)
npm run gate:playability reports 0 blockers
If P9 near-duplicate warnings exceed baseline: root cause documented; fix behavior first; baseline update only with written justification in test report
Update docs/test-reports/p8-playability-gate-latest.md so Early narrative samples reflect 0–4 passive (not 0-year three-action planning)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-002; §8 test commands; FR-1–FR-8 validation artifacts under docs/test-reports/; success metrics §9 gate:p16 + gate:playability; risks §10 (do not blindly raise P9 baseline); depends on US-001 baseline confirmation

userStories.title: Preschool Agency API Browser Playtest
userStories.description: As a player experience reviewer, I want 3–4 year old play to feel passive with only spine choices so that early life matches age expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: API mode + browser: 书香门第 origin, advance to ≥4 years and complete 童年偏好 choice
Ages 3–4: planningOptions.length === 0 for all observed periods (no 听先生讲课/玩耍练功/与玩伴 three-action planning)
Age 4: at least one formal story_event choice (童年偏好) with 2–3 options
Before every 继续 click: main narrative or periodSummary card is non-empty
Within 35 steps: placeholder 本期暂无强求的江湖变故… appears ≤3 times total; ages 0–4 show 0 occurrences
No chivalry/internalSkill absurd jumps after first passive segment at age 0
Save report under docs/test-reports/api-browser-playtest-stage2.md with reproducible setup (p6b:serve + dev)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill or documented manual script equivalent
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-003; §3 frozen 3–4 passive + age-4 spine; FR-1, FR-2, FR-5, FR-6; success metrics §9 (0 planning at 0–2, 0 placeholder before age 4, ≤3 placeholders in 35 steps, ≥95% non-empty narrative); §8 API browser authoritative over headless; non-goals §6 (no P20 pacing rewrite, no bulk 0–7 conflict events); depends on US-002 gates green

userStories.title: Four-Origin Early Childhood Divergence Audit
userStories.description: As a designer, I want measurable origin divergence in ages 0–7 so that replay value is observable before investing in full quest chains.
acceptanceCriteria: Run four origins (书香门第 / 武林世家 / 商贾之家 / 边疆异族) each to age 7 in API or headless mode
Record narrative and passive event id lists per origin
Pairwise compare all C(4,2)=6 origin pairs: narrative id overlap <50% for each pair
Ages 0–2: 10 periods each origin — 0 planning three-choices; no chivalry/internalSkill absurd jumps
Save audit under docs/test-reports/early-childhood-origin-divergence-stage2.md with reproducible commands
If any pair overlap ≥50%: report notes expected improvement from Stage-3/4 PRDs; this story does not implement content fixes
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-004; §9 success metric pairwise overlap <50%; open Q3 (Stage-3 origin chains + Stage-4 density own fixes); FR-7 origin-tagged passive selection; non-goals §6 (Stage-3/4 not implemented here); Q1 Stage-2 failure does not block Stage-3/4 parallel PRDs; depends on US-002 gates green; can run parallel with US-003

userStories.title: Stage-2 Experience Governance Closure
userStories.description: As a product owner, I want a single closure summary tying gates and playtests together so that the team can decide whether to open Stage-3.
acceptanceCriteria: Create docs/test-reports/early-childhood-opening-experience-stage2-closure.md
Closure doc references US-002 through US-004 evidence paths (gate reports, api-browser-playtest-stage2.md, origin-divergence-stage2.md)
Notes baseline metrics for Stage-3/4 sub-agents (overlap %, placeholder counts, playtest rating vs 2026-06-17 ★★☆ baseline)
Lists residual risks (e.g. passive repetition, spine density, 5–7 lite planning monotony)
No code changes in this story
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-005; §2 goals (handoff report for Stage-3 approval); §10 rollback by story reverse order; non-goals §6; suite index early-childhood-opening-experience-index.md; depends on US-003 and US-004
